# Kanban

## Summary
Kanban column-board interaction. The platform kit lives in
`@cardstack/boxel-ui` (`KanbanPlane`, `KanbanCard`, `KanbanColumnHeader`,
`KanbanDragManager`, sidebar config components) — an npm package, not a
realm module, so this spec's ref points at the shared-realm **Board**
block, which is the realm-consumable realization built directly on
`KanbanPlane`.

## API (Board block)
- `@items` — cards to lay out; `@columns` — `KanbanColumnConfig[]`
- placement callbacks map drops back onto card fields

## Usage
```gts
import { Board } from './board';

<Board @items={{this.deals}} @columns={{this.stageColumns}} />
```
The linked example is the Revenue OS app, whose Pipeline tab is this board
over Opportunity stages (drag between columns patches the card).
